verdict.label: TEST-FIRST
verdict.p_go_note: upper bound: gates G5 have no prior probability yet
reasons: G1 Aflatoxin B1: AFB1 not measured by HPLC; prior P(fail) = 0.53 [published]. Test a composite of ≥ 10 sub-samples (sampling error often dominates assay error).
G5 Food-grade provenance: feed-grade or unknown supply and open or unknown storage: run a micro panel; re-source if possible
Key evidence is transferred from other materials: must be demonstrated on this one.
Base protein is about 48% against 60% required: flour cannot reach it; a protein concentration (fractionation) step is needed.
actions: Run afb1_elisa + afb1_hplc (G1); flips when measured <= 0.5 x limit on a representative composite sample.
Run micro_panel (G5); flips when passing micro panel + hygienic supply.

budget_inr.note: not computable: lab test costs are missing in lab_tests.json (see DATA_TODO); get NABL lab quotes

plan.pilot_partner: A feed-grade mill moving one line to food grade, with an accredited (NABL) testing lab and an incubator or institute pilot plant. Name institutions only after the team has spoken to them.

limitations: Inputs are sampled independently (no correlations between inputs).
Functionality fit (solubility, emulsification, gelation) is a qualitative flag, not a computed score.

9 fractions have no data and are sampled over their full 0-1 range (assumed, grade D), e.g. ae_iep: trypsin_inhibitor reduction, extrude: mass yield, extrude: protein retention. Ranges are wide on purpose.
Costs are lower bounds: missing QA cost, capital, chemicals, energy, labour, overhead, water inputs are excluded.
Off-flavour index not computable: no sensory baseline data for this by-product.
Treatments not considered: stabilise (no listed effect on this by-product); ssf_ferment (needs fermenter); ethanol_wash (excluded by user)
Value of information uses lower-bound costs, so margins (and test values) may be optimistic; gates without a prior (all but G1) are not part of the utility.
This is a proof of concept; the next step is laboratory validation.
disclaimer: Proof of concept. Not a substitute for laboratory validation. Decision support only. Not a regulatory approval. Confirm FSSAI classification and limits.
